ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure respectively plots the land-use area grades of major cities in Jiangsu in 1979 and 2000; the larger the dot, the larger the urban land-use area. The legend includes greater than 100 km², 40—100 km², 20—40 km², and less than 20 km². Looking horizontally, in 2000, in southern Jiangsu areas such as Nanjing, Suzhou, Wuxi, and Changzhou, there were obviously more large dots, and the urban land-use area grade was relatively high; while northern Jiangsu and some coastal areas were still dominated by smaller dots, and the grade was relatively low. Then reason: expansion of urban land-use area can reflect an increase in the level of urbanization development. From 1979 to 2000, Jiangsu urbanization was not advanced evenly in all regions, but southern Jiangsu developed faster and more concentratedly, while northern Jiangsu was relatively weaker; therefore it showed obvious regional differences.

method.method_draft: 根据题干确定要判断1979—2000年江苏城市化的区域特征。先描述图像：图中给出1979年和2000年江苏主要城市用地面积等级，圆点越大表示用地面积越大。横向比较各区域，发现苏南地区大圆点城市较多、等级较高，苏北及部分沿海地区小圆点较多、等级较低。由城市用地面积代表城市化发展程度，推出江苏城市化不是均衡推进，而是区域差异明显。

raw_record.original_question: 城市首位度（区域最大城市与第二大城市人口规模之比）通常可以用来反映一个国家或地区的城市规模和人口集中程度。下图为江苏省主要城市用地面积变化图。根据<image1>，1979—2000年江苏省城市化表现出怎样的区域特征？
raw_record.answer: Regional differences in urbanization are obvious
raw_record.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure respectively plots the land-use area grades of major cities in Jiangsu in 1979 and 2000; the larger the dot, the larger the urban land-use area. The legend includes greater than 100 km², 40—100 km², 20—40 km², and less than 20 km². Looking horizontally, in 2000, in southern Jiangsu areas such as Nanjing, Suzhou, Wuxi, and Changzhou, there were obviously more large dots, and the urban land-use area grade was relatively high; while northern Jiangsu and some coastal areas were still dominated by smaller dots, and the grade was relatively low. Then reason: expansion of urban land-use area can reflect an increase in the level of urbanization development. From 1979 to 2000, Jiangsu urbanization was not advanced evenly in all regions, but southern Jiangsu developed faster and more concentratedly, while northern Jiangsu was relatively weaker; therefore it showed obvious regional differences.
